messages:
Liam: pinging the group — Glimmer pilot kickoff today. Need clarity on entitlements, SSO handoff, telemetry and pricing for a shared POC. CTO asked for an estimated monthly token cost and a short runbook we can hand to their infra team. cc @Nora (Glimmer)

Nora (Glimmer): thanks Liam — timeline is 3 weeks, target 10k requests/day at peak. We need SSO via SAML, basic request/response telemetry, and a cost estimate for both Hosted (no commit) and Dedicated reserved for 3 months. Also, Glimmer legal sent a short security questionnaire (I can upload).

Jamal: do we have an expected tokens per request? 10k req/day could mean very different costs.

Elaine: quick guestimate — if avg prompt+response ~2k tokens, 10k req/day -> ~20M tokens/day -> ~600M tokens/month. Hosted price ballpark (public API) ~$0.0004/token gen -> ~240k/mo. Dedicated reserved would be lower per-token but requires committed capacity and infra cost; rough delta depends on GPU type. I'll put numbers together but need exact token profile.

Maya: tagging revops — for a 3-month pilot we typically offer a pilot discount and consumption cap. Need customer billing entity and PO expectation. Also any entitlements (telemetry retention, audit logs) affects pricing.

Sam: SSO/SAML: we can do IdP-initiated SAML or OIDC. For Glimmer, SAML is fine. I need their IdP metadata and a test SP. Minimal SAML config we usually hand them:
```
entityID: https://redwood.example/saml/metadata
acs: https://redwood.example/saml/acs
nameIDFormat: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
certificate: <public cert>
```
Once we have metadata we can spin up a dev tenant and validate within 48h.

Nora (Glimmer): we can send metadata today. For telemetry: we need request_id, model, latency_ms, success/failure, and user_id hash. retention 90 days. Is that doable?

Sam: yes, those fields are standard. We can wire a webhook to Glimmer's telemetry ingest (json events) or provide S3 dumps. Webhook schema:
```json
{"request_id":"...","model":"...","latency_ms":123,"status":"ok","user_hash":"..."}
```
We'll confirm event shape in the onboarding doc.

Alex (security) via deploy-bot: deploy-bot posted https://redwood.internal/runbooks/partner-pilot-security-checklist — includes minimum answers for vendor questionnaires + required certs and audit evidence.

Jamal: for entitlements - who owns the billing account during pilot? Partner or customer? We need that to set quotas/entitlements correctly.

Maya: usually partner-managed for co-sell POCs. We'll set partner as billing owner with a capped budget and alerts. Revops will produce a quote for both Hosted and Dedicated options tomorrow.

Elaine: ops note — if they want <100ms p95 we should plan for Dedicated on A10x or similar. Otherwise Hosted with autoscaling + KV cache should hit 200-300ms. Also recommend prefix caching on system prompts to lower token counts.

Nora (Glimmer): noted. Can you also share a short runbook that our infra can follow to validate connectivity + SAML?

Sam: putting a minimal runbook snippet here for onboarding steps: 
1) exchange IdP metadata
2) RDW provide test tenant + API key for partner/dev
3) verify SAML login flow and map groups -> roles
4) smoke test 100 requests against dev endpoint and confirm telemetry events
5) confirm perf SLA (p95 latency) and cost target

I'll draft a one-page runbook and attach. ETA 24h.

Liam: awesome — thank you everyone. Action items: Sam draft runbook (24h), Elaine + Jamal finalize token cost estimate (EOD), Maya output preliminary quote (tomorrow), Nora to upload IdP and security questionnaire. I'll keep Glimmer PM looped. :thumbsup:

Nora (Glimmer): uploading questionnaire now. thanks team!

Maya: I filed an internal quote ticket #Q-3778 and linked it to this thread. Will update when revops has concrete numbers.

Elaine: added a note about caching patterns to reduce tokens — will include a small example prompt rewrite.

Liam: closing loop for now, will follow up after documents land.

deploy-bot: runbook draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/partner-gateway-pilot-onboard-draft.pdf
